items.headline: Albemarle Upgrade: Can Energy Storage Recharge Lithium's Leader?
items.snippet: Commodity stocks are expected to be strong performers. But it's been a rough year for lithium stocks. Albemarle Corp. (NYSE: ALB) is down over 33% in 2026, but it just got a bullish spark. On Oct. 14, Mizuho's John Roberts upgraded the lithium giant to Outperform from Neutral.

items.headline: Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat
items.snippet: Battery storage is building a second floor of demand, and Western reshoring gives established domestic producers like Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) outsized leverage.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Albemarle faces persistent headwinds from weaker Energy Storage volumes, falling lithium prices, and rising supply-chain costs. Zacks Underperform view.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares.
